about: The "Pass deals" teaser and the members' block on the same snapshot. `otd` is a small snapshot exactly as the server serves it (advisor/snapshot.py _otd_json, without picks and starters), `rules` the pass rules it serves with it (_otd_rules) and `budgets` each level's default pass budget (rules.LEVELS otd_default_budget). For each level, `expect` is what both sides must find: advisor/pass_deals.py teaser() gives its `passes` and `best_pct`, and frontend/src/lib/passDeals.ts passDeals() at that level, its default budget, nothing held, on every sport ("all") gives the passes in `keys`, in that order (a member sees each on its sport's tab, the first PASS_DEALS_SHOWN on "all"), and the same best saving, the deepest of those first ones, rounded the same way. `body` and `title` are what the locked teaser then reads (components/PassDeals.tsx lockedWords): the percent only from PASS_DEALS_PCT_MIN up, the count alone under it. `why` says what each pass is there for. tests/test_pass_deals_parity.py and frontend/src/lib/passDealsParity.test.ts read it; `uv run python -m tests.test_pass_deals_parity` serves `otd` again from its own passes after an engine change.
